question: After P01 residual_scale=0.25 three-seed failure vs A4, what is the route?
reason: P01 answered its research question with 0/3 positive seeds and mean Δlast≈−0.040 vs accepted A4. Residual scaling does not add gain under the frozen A4 stack; weakening the residual path hurts. Combined with prior P00 (gated+FDPN negative) vs A4 (early_concat+FDPN positive), the line converges to A4 as the final method. Further α search would become parameter hunting and weaken the paper narrative.

method_selection.keep: A4 early_concat + FDPN (formal candidate → final method)

allowed_conclusion: Under the K2-C formal protocol, A4 (early_concat+FDPN) consistently outperforms A2 across three seeds; residual scaling (0.25) yields no extra gain and degrades last@20; gated fusion + FDPN previously showed no synergistic gain, indicating structure dependence between fusion strategy and multi-scale enhancement.
disallowed_claims: FDPN always helps regardless of fusion
